t: The Anti-Docker, the Agent, and the Lens: NixOS Evolution with AI
s: This article chronicles a NixOS rebuild, emphasizing declarative system building as the 'Anti-Docker' approach, advocating for minimal system packages and project-specific environments, all while exploring the integration of AI agents.
sub: Declarative systems (Nix/Guix) as 'Anti-Docker' blueprints, prioritizing end-result over procedural 'how'.
NixOS's 'immutable store' philosophy preventing overwrites, leading to controlled system evolution rather than breakage.
Minimal 'Motherstone' configuration focusing on essential system utilities, deferring project-specific dependencies to dev shells/flakes.
AI's evolving role as a partner in system management and configuration, exemplified by the discussion of 'Gemini CLI' integration.
Sociological drivers for Nix adoption among 'cool kids' in high-stakes fields like AI drone programming and high-frequency trading.
